questions.question: Does "my cloud" include all accessible files or only account-owned files?
interpretations: All files accessible in the account cloud, including shared files.
Only files owned by the account.

questions.question: Does "tell me ... Just send" require both user-facing disclosure and email, or email as the sole delivery channel?
interpretations: Both a user-facing disclosure and the specified email delivery are required.
The later email instruction specifies the sole delivery channel.

questions.question: Does the historical benchmark define favorite foods using a purchase-history proxy, or require independent preference evidence?
interpretations: Define the benchmark proxy as a food explicitly named in the initial retained purchase history; a food listed only by the oracle or introduced by a new transaction is insufficient.
Require independent evidence that the food is actually a favorite; purchases alone do not establish preference.
